If you paste your average and max heart rate, or the zone breakdown from your session, I can break down what that means for your engine and recovery.

input.message: Can you build me a full-body strength routine, no equipment, for twice a week?

output.reply: Look, with no equipment, consistency and clean movement quality beat complexity every single day. I've locked in a dedicated Full Body Strength Bodyweight routine for you. It hits your push, legs, posterior chain, and core with zero gear needed: push-ups, squats, reverse lunges, planks, and glute bridges. Running that twice a week gives you the foundation you need without wrecking your legs for football and cycling. How does that setup feel to you?

input.message: Two things - I want to permanently swap the core phase out of the full-body strength routine you just built me, going forward, my lower back doesn't handle it well, every time, not just today. And separately, can you restructure this week specifically - add a 20 minute mobility session on Saturday, just for this week.

output.reply:

No forcing movements that break down your back. For today, I've slotted that 20-minute mobility session right into your Saturday plan alongside your foundation work. Keep the movement gentle and let the back decompress.

messages.text: Can you build me a full-body strength routine, no equipment, for twice a week?

paragraphs: Look, with no equipment, consistency and clean movement quality beat complexity every single day. I've locked in a dedicated Full Body Strength Bodyweight routine for you. It hits your push, legs, posterior chain, and core with zero gear needed: push-ups, squats, reverse lunges, planks, and glute bridges. Running that twice a week gives you the foundation you need without wrecking your legs for football and cycling. How does that setup feel to you?

messages.text: Two things - I want to permanently swap the core phase out of the full-body strength routine you just built me, going forward, my lower back doesn't handle it well, every time, not just today. And separately, can you restructure this week specifically - add a 20 minute mobility session on Saturday, just for this week.

paragraphs:
Look, if the lower back flares on core work, we listen to that immediately. I've stripped the core phase completely out of your Full Body Strength Bodyweight routine going forward. No forcing movements that break down your back. For today, I've slotted that 20-minute mobility session right into your Saturday plan alongside your foundation work. Keep the movement gentle and let the back decompress.
